summary: Momentus Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of 1,851,852 shares of Class A common stock at $13.50/share, for gross proceeds of $25M. The offering is not a special situation but an ordinary equity raise to fund operations. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners is the placement agent, receiving a 7% cash fee and five-year warrants exercisable at 110% of the offering price. Delivery is expected on or about June 15, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. What to watch: dilution impact and use of proceeds; no risk-arb angle as it is not a merger or acquisition event.
